title: Clock and day indicator
body:
## Overview
This simple mod includes real time clock and day indicators in lower right corner of the screen. 
![Real time and day](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/939b89f75032cc373adbbd7b324a3a71ebc512c4.png)
## Features
- **Day counter** starts with 0 and is calculated by updating numeric variable every game tick and then dividing it by number of ticks per day.
- **Real-time clock** is synchronized with the computer clock and is directly dependent on the current time set on the computer. For now, only 24-hour time is available (I have plans to implement new features in the next versions).
## Hotkey
By default indicator is attached to backslash key, but can be changed in UI section.

_This is my first ever mod and I made it using MCreator, please report any bugs you find and how this mod can be improved ^.^_
